opportunity.title: Sizing Technology Pilot (Army Call for Solutions)
opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Call for Solutions under Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002)
opportunity.description: Army Contracting Command-Aberdeen Proving Ground, on behalf of HQDA G-4, seeks mature commercial technology that captures body and foot measurements by automated non-contact methods and translates them into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Current manual tape measurement at accession points causes bottlenecks and high uniform and boot return rates and keeps no record of sizing changes over time. Evaluation phases and required attributes are in Attachment 1. Questions were due Oct 13 2026. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: The opportunity centers on digital sizing technology that uses wearer data to generate accurate size recommendations quickly and at scale (claim #1), which aligns with the company's core data analytics capabilities.
The company holds NAICS 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services) matching the opportunity's NAICS, and the eligibility gate passed for deadline, NAICS, and place of performance.

However, the opportunity has no set-aside (full and open competition), exposing a small business with 11 staff and no facility clearance to large competitors; past performance is strongest in training and education data systems, not specifically sizing technology.
The median award size for top DoD NAICS 541512 awards is ~$237M, indicating typical awards are large; this pilot may be smaller but still carries high competition risk for a firm of this size.

risks: Full and open competition with no small business set-aside
Limited past performance directly relevant to digital sizing technology
Small staff (11) may limit capacity for pilot execution
No facility clearance could be a barrier if security requirements emerge
High median award values suggest large-scale expectations
nextSteps: Assess teaming options with a larger prime or complementary small business
Request clarification on pilot scope, budget, and security requirements
Evaluate whether existing training data analytics experience can be credibly mapped to sizing technology use case
Prepare a capability statement highlighting data analytics, rapid prototyping, and wearable data experience

classification.summary: The Army needs a mature commercial technology that automatically captures body and foot measurements without contact to generate recommended uniform and footwear sizes, reducing bottlenecks and returns.
